name: Senso-ji Temple
description: Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple. Walk through the dramatic Kaminarimon gate, explore Nakamise shopping street, and experience traditional Japanese spirituality in the heart of modern Tokyo.

name: TeamLab Borderless
description: A mesmerizing digital art museum where immersive installations react to your presence. Wander through endless rooms of flowing lights, cascading waterfalls, and interactive projections — a deeply romantic experience for couples.
booking_note: Book 2-3 weeks in advance, timed entry slots

name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
description: Thousands of vermillion torii gates wind up the mountainside creating an ethereal tunnel of color. Best visited early morning for photography and to avoid crowds. The full hike takes 2-3 hours.

name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
description: Walk through towering bamboo stalks that sway and creak in the wind, creating a magical natural cathedral. Arrive before 8 AM for a serene, crowd-free experience perfect for couples.

name: Private Tea Ceremony
description: An intimate private tea ceremony in a traditional machiya townhouse in Gion. Learn the art of matcha preparation from a tea master while surrounded by centuries-old Japanese aesthetics.
booking_note: Reserve 1 week ahead, private sessions for 2

name: Dotonbori Street Walk
description: Osaka's neon-lit culinary heartland. Sample takoyaki, okonomiyaki, and street-side gyoza while soaking in the electric atmosphere of giant billboards and canal-side energy.

name: Osaka Castle
description: Japan's most famous castle surrounded by moats and parkland. Explore the museum inside, then stroll the expansive grounds with views of the Osaka skyline.

name: Sunset Dolphin Cruise
description: A private sunset cruise aboard a luxury dhoni with champagne and canapés. Watch dolphins play in the golden hour light while sailing through the UNESCO biosphere reserve.
booking_note: Book through resort concierge 48 hours ahead

name: Private Snorkeling at Hanifaru Bay
description: Snorkel in the world's largest congregation of manta rays at this UNESCO biosphere site. Private guide and speedboat transfer from resort included.

name: Overwater Spa Ritual
description: A couple's spa journey in an overwater pavilion with glass floor panels revealing the reef below. Includes aromatherapy massage, sound healing, and organic refreshments.
booking_note: Reserve at check-in for preferred time slots

name: Amber Fort
description: The magnificent hilltop fortress with intricate mirror work, sprawling courtyards, and panoramic views. Explore the Sheesh Mahal, Diwan-e-Aam, and secret underground tunnels.
booking_note: Arrive before 9 AM to beat the heat

name: Mehrangarh Fort
description: One of India's largest forts, towering 400 feet above the Blue City. Houses an extraordinary museum with palanquins, armor, and paintings. The rampart views are breathtaking.

name: Lake Pichola Sunset Boat Ride
description: Glide across the shimmering waters of Lake Pichola at sunset, passing the floating Jag Mandir and Lake Palace. The golden light illuminating the Aravalli hills creates an unforgettable romantic backdrop.
booking_note: Book through hotel, private boats available

name: Tegallalang Rice Terraces
description: Dramatic cascading rice paddies carved into the hillside. Walk through the sub-irrigation system dating back centuries and enjoy coffee overlooking the emerald green terraces.

name: Private Sunset at Tanah Lot
description: Bali's most iconic sea temple perched on a rock formation surrounded by crashing waves. Visit during golden hour for spectacular sunset views and traditional Kecak fire dance performances.
booking_note: Arrive 1 hour before sunset for best spots

name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
description: Explore the vibrant outer market with guided tastings of the freshest sushi, tamagoyaki, wagyu skewers, and seasonal delicacies. A feast for all senses.
booking_note: Guided tours book out fast, reserve 3 days ahead

name: Meiji Shrine
description: A serene forest shrine in the heart of Tokyo dedicated to Emperor Meiji. Walk through the towering torii gate and pristine forested path. A peaceful start to any morning — ideal for couples seeking a quiet, spiritual moment together.

name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
description: One of Tokyo's most beautiful gardens blending Japanese, English, and French landscape styles. Stroll through cherry blossom groves, koi ponds, and manicured lawns. In March, the garden becomes a romantic paradise of pink blossoms.

name: Blue City Heritage Walk
description: Wander through the maze of indigo-painted lanes in the shadow of Mehrangarh Fort. Visit spice markets, artisan workshops, and hidden step wells while learning about the Brahmin traditions behind the blue walls.
booking_note: Book guided walk through hotel, morning slot recommended

name: Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary
description: An ancient sanctuary where hundreds of long-tailed macaques live among moss-covered temples and banyan trees. Walk the shaded paths, cross dragon-guarded bridges, and witness centuries-old Hindu carvings.
booking_note: Keep belongings secure, no food visible

name: Potato Head Beach Club
description: Bali's most iconic sustainable beach club with infinity pools, ocean views, and world-class cocktails. Watch the sunset from a daybed while DJs set the mood. A perfect celebration venue.
booking_note: Reserve daybed 3 days ahead for sunset session

name: Hawa Mahal
description: The iconic 'Palace of Winds' with its 953 honeycomb windows designed for royal women to observe street life unseen. The facade glows pink at sunrise — a photographer's dream and Jaipur's most recognizable landmark.
booking_note: Best photographed from the street-facing cafes opposite

name: City Palace Jaipur
description: A magnificent fusion of Rajasthani and Mughal architecture still partially occupied by the royal family. Explore the stunning Peacock Gate, textile gallery, and the grand Diwan-e-Khas audience hall.

name: City Palace Udaipur
description: Rajasthan's largest palace complex perched above Lake Pichola. Wander through ornate balconies, mirror mosaics, and rooftop gardens with sweeping views of the lake and Aravalli hills.
booking_note: Light and sound show available in evening

name: Stargazing Observatory
description: Gaze at the Milky Way through Soneva Fushi's professional-grade telescope with a resident astronomer. The Maldives' minimal light pollution offers some of the clearest night skies on earth — a deeply romantic experience.

name: Private Sandbank Picnic
description: Be dropped off on a deserted white sandbank surrounded by turquoise waters with a gourmet picnic hamper and champagne. Complete privacy with nothing but ocean, sky, and your partner.

name: Ubud Royal Palace
description: The historic seat of the Ubud royal family with traditional Balinese architecture and lush gardens. Catch the evening Legong dance performance in the courtyard for a magical cultural immersion.
booking_note: Evening dance shows at 19:30, arrive early for front seats
